frames.title: Lesson 153 · Advanced relative clauses — production and review

body: **Foco:** Advanced relative clauses — produção e revisão.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (análises).
**Texto do dia:** biografia.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo produzir uma biografia com relativas avançadas (whose, in which, the work of whom) e revisar pontuação e preposições.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.name: Dr. Iris Calder (fictional ecologist)
paras: Iris Calder, **whose** research on wetlands changed regional policy, was born in a village **where** the river flooded every spring. Her doctoral thesis, **the findings of which** were published in 2008, showed how wetlands protect towns **that** lie downstream.

She worked with a team **most of whom** were volunteers, and with farmers **for whom** water was a daily worry. Her book, **in which** she explains the science simply, has been translated into six languages. “Science,” she says, “is a conversation **to which** everyone belongs.”

items.q: Calder was born in a village near a river that flooded each spring.
Her book has been translated into two languages.
She thinks science belongs only to experts.

head: Verifique
Exemplo
rows: farmers **for whom** water was a worry
a team **most of whom** were volunteers
verbo concorda com o antecedente: towns **that lie**

blocks.body: Revise: (1) preposição antes do pronome? (2) vírgulas só em não restritivas? (3) o verbo concorda com o **antecedente**?
✗ *a team most of who* → ✓ *most of whom*.

items.s: Calder, ___ research changed policy, grew up near a river. (whose)
Farmers for ___ water was a worry joined her. (whom)
She worked with a team most ___ whom were volunteers. (of)
Her book, in ___ she explains the science, was translated. (which)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Dr Calder how did you start

body: **a person to whom I owe a great deal** — uma pessoa a quem devo muito
**the work of which she is proudest** — o trabalho de que ela mais se orgulha
**a conversation to which everyone belongs** — uma conversa à qual todos pertencem
**Leave a lasting legacy** — Deixar um legado duradouro
**Pave the way for…** — Abrir caminho para…
**Blaze a trail** — Abrir novos caminhos
**Give back** — Retribuir
**Make a mark** — Deixar sua marca
**Dr. Calder, how did you start?** — Dra. Calder, como começou?
**And who helped you?** — E quem ajudou?
**A team, most of whom were volunteers.** — Uma equipe, a maioria voluntários.

blocks.title: Interview
lines: Dr. Calder, how did you start?
In a village where the river flooded every spring.
Em um vilarejo onde o rio transbordava toda primavera.
A team, most of whom were volunteers.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: Pausas e ritmo: faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido; o ritmo do inglês se apoia nas sílabas fortes, e as fracas se encolhem.
words: In my view, | the evidence | is mixed.
Having read the report, | she agreed.
On the one hand, | it works.

prompts.model: She is a scientist whose work changed policy.
He is a farmer for whom water is a daily worry.
She had a team, most of whom were volunteers.

blocks.task: Write a 7-sentence mini-biography of a real or fictional person using at least five different relative structures.
blocks.model: Elena Duarte, whose paintings hang in three museums, grew up in a town where nothing was ever painted. Her teacher, to whom she owes everything, gave her a first brush. She worked with artists, most of whom were self-taught. Her best work, the colours of which are unforgettable, is on display this month. It is a city that she loves. She says art is a language in which everyone can speak.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
